intro: The Habit Burger Grill is the California-born chain (now owned by Yum! Brands) built on the chargrilled Charburger, cooked over an open flame, along with a grilled albacore tuna sandwich, chicken sandwiches, big salads, fresh-cut fries and hand-scooped shakes. Below is the full Habit Burger Grill menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At The Habit Burger Grill, a Charburger is about $4.49 (with cheese $5.09), a double Charburger with cheese $6.09, and the #1 Original Charburger meal $8.49. Chicken sandwiches are $6.99 to $7.99, the albacore sandwich $8.29, salads $4.99 to $8.99, and a shake $4.69. The chargrilled Charburger is the signature. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Habit Burger value: a plain Charburger ($4.49) and fresh-cut fries ($2.49) are the cheapest way in, and the #1 Original meal ($8.49) bundles a Charburger, fries and a drink. Kids meals are $4.99. The app and Habit rewards drop occasional deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Charburger at The Habit?
faqs.a: A plain Charburger is about $4.49 and with cheese $5.09, a double Charburger with cheese $6.09, and the #1 Original Charburger meal (with fries and a drink) $8.49. It is one of the better-value chargrilled burgers in fast food. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is The Habit Burger Grill known for?
faqs.a: The Habit is known for its chargrilled Charburger, cooked over an open flame, which famously won a burger taste test years ago. It is also known for its grilled albacore tuna sandwich and its tempura-fried green beans. It is now owned by Yum! Brands.

faqs.q: Does The Habit have a tuna sandwich?
faqs.a: Yes. The grilled albacore tuna sandwich is one of The Habit's signatures, a hot grilled tuna fillet sandwich rather than cold tuna salad, about $8.29 or $13.29 as a meal. It is unusual among burger chains and a fan favorite.

faqs.q: Does The Habit Burger Grill list calories?
faqs.a: The Habit publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. Totals depend on the burger size, cheese, toppings and whether you add fries and a shake.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at The Habit?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Charburger, the double Charburger, the albacore tuna sandwich, the tempura-fried green beans, and the hand-scooped shakes.
